name: Kaban Luggage
description: Kaban Luggage is a quiet, refined WordPress store theme designed for bespoke luggage fitting and travel goods shops. Built with full WooCommerce support, it combines low-key documentary imagery, tactile paper textures, and structured product specification catalogues. The design features elegant typography, smooth scroll reveals, and dedicated layouts for workshop services and personal fittings.
